```{r}

save_path_data <- "C:/Users/DBT3KD/Desktop/Etude_macro_elec/DATA/esp/renewable_forecast"
setwd(save_path_data)

renewable_forecasts <- read_parquet('renewable_forecasts.parquet')
colnames(renewable_forecasts)
```

```{r}

first_stage_combined <- left_join(first_stage_data %>% select(-c('gen_tot')),
                                  renewable_forecasts, 
      by = c('datetime' = '__index_level_0__'))

colnames(first_stage_combined)



capacity_fields <- c("Published.Unavailable.Capacity"          
,"Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity" ,  "Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity"        
, "Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity", "gen_tot",
"wind_solar_tot", "unpredicted_renewables", "intraday_update_renewables")

#adjuster l'ordre de grandeur des indispos pour ne pas avoir des coefficients nuls
first_stage_combined_clean <- first_stage_combined %>%
  filter(is.finite(log_price_diff) & 
           is.finite(Published.Unavailable.Capacity) & is.finite(intraday_update_renewables))%>% 
   mutate(across(all_of(capacity_fields), 
                ~ . / 1000))


first_stage_combined_5 <- first_stage_combined_clean %>% 
    filter(auction_before == 5)

first_stage_combined_5


```




```{r}

# perform first stage regression
m_basic <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ intraday_update_renewables 
  + wind_solar_tot  + gen_tot,
  data= first_stage_combined_5 )

m_control <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~  intraday_update_renewables 
  +wind_solar_tot +unpredicted_renewables + gen_tot + factor(creneau),
  data= first_stage_combined_5 )

m_without_renew <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~  intraday_update_renewables +unpredicted_renewables + gen_tot + factor(creneau),
  data= first_stage_combined_5 )

# m_with_plants <- lm(

```


```{r, results = 'asis'}
# Create LaTeX code with regression results
reg_intraday <- stargazer(m_basic, m_control, 
                                m_without_renew, 
                          #m_with_plants,
    type = "text",
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("Basic", "Creneau FE", "without renewables", "with plants"),
    keep = c('Constant', 'unpredicted_renewables','intraday_update_renewables', 'wind_solar_tot', 'gen_tot',
             capacity_fields))
 
```
